intent.proves: No form lacks an active field.

bindings.reason: Requires a call per form and aggregation; handler not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(f.FormId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(f.FormName, N'') FROM Form f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FormField ff WHERE ff.FormFieldFormId = f.FormId AND ff.FormFieldActive = 1)
